neighbours.label: The prefix 'super' (Superintendent, superior, super idea, superimposed)
fire: The district superintendent met with parents on Monday evening.
That was a super idea for the school fair.
The Super Bowl drew a record audience this year.
A new layer was superimposed on the original map.
The superintendent of police addressed the crowd.
We had a super time at the lake last weekend.
Chefs served a super sized portion of fries.
The deputy superintendent resigned after the audit.
quiet: The district principal met with parents on Monday evening.
That was a great idea for the school fair.
The Rose Bowl drew a record audience this year.
A new layer was overlaid on the original map.
The commissioner of police addressed the crowd.
We had a lovely time at the lake last weekend.
Chefs served an extra large portion of fries.
The deputy director resigned after the audit.
